description: Android Fragment class for camera video recording using Camera2 API, handling camera setup, preview, and video recording functionalities.

classes.name: CompareSizesByArea
classes.description: Comparator class for comparing Size objects based on their area.

methods.name: chooseVideoSize
methods.description: Selects a suitable video size with 4:3 aspect ratio and max 1080p resolution.

methods.name: chooseOptimalSize
methods.description: Selects the smallest size that meets minimum width, height, and aspect ratio requirements.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts background thread and opens camera if TextureView is available.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Closes camera and stops background thread.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles UI button clicks for recording and info dialog.

methods.name: startBackgroundThread
methods.description: Starts a background thread for camera operations.

methods.name: stopBackgroundThread
methods.description: Stops the background thread.

methods.name: shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale
methods.description: Determines if permission rationale should be shown.

methods.name: requestVideoPermissions
methods.description: Requests camera and audio permissions for video recording.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request results.

methods.name: hasPermissionsGranted
methods.description: Checks if required permissions are granted.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.description: Initializes camera device, sizes, and media recorder.

methods.name: closeCamera
methods.description: Closes camera device and media recorder.

methods.name: startPreview
methods.description: Starts camera preview session.

methods.name: updatePreview
methods.description: Updates the camera preview request.

methods.name: setUpCaptureRequestBuilder
methods.description: Configures capture request settings.

methods.name: configureTransform
methods.description: Applies transformation matrix to TextureView based on device rotation.

methods.name: setUpMediaRecorder
methods.description: Configures MediaRecorder for video recording.

methods.name: getVideoFilePath
methods.description: Generates file path for saving video.

methods.name: startRecordingVideo
methods.description: Begins video recording session.

methods.name: closePreviewSession
methods.description: Closes current camera capture session.

methods.name: stopRecordingVideo
methods.description: Stops video recording and resets MediaRecorder.
